sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_organizations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_branches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES business_organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "code"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_warehouses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES business_organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "code"), UNIQUE ("id", "branch_id", "organization_id"), FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES business_branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_contexts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "warehouse_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "database_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "foundation_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES business_branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id, branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES business_warehouses (id, branch_id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (foundation_version = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "employee_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "security_question" TEXT NULL, "security_answer_hash" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_login_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_base" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_base" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "store_logos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "logo_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES product_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_colors" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hex_code" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sizes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sku" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "name_fr" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES product_categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "supplier_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "last_purchase_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "currency_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES currencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "track_inventory" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("track_inventory" IN (0, 1)), "measurement_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "min_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "has_variants" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_variants" IN (0, 1)), "is_taxable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_taxable" IN (0, 1)), "purchase_tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sales_tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "image_path" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "costing_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wac', "inventory_tracking_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sku" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "color_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES product_colors (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "size_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES sizes (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "previous_wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "last_purchase_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "price_adjustment_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_price_histories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "variant_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "old_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "old_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "old_wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "new_wholesale_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "user_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "change_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "variant_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "batch_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "purchase_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES purchase_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "supplier_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'purchase', "received_date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "expiry_date" TEXT NULL, "received_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batch_consumptions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "batch_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES product_batches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "consumption_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES sale_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_return_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES sale_return_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_return_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES purchase_return_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "inventory_adjustment_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES inventory_adjustments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_return_adjustment_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES purchase_return_adjustment_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_return_adjustment_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES sale_return_adjustment_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "canonical_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "name_fr" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_ingredient_aliases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ingredient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES active_ingredients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_alias" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "language_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicine_profiles" ("product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "dosage_form" TEXT NOT NULL, "administration_route" TEXT NULL, "substitution_eligible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("substitution_eligible" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicine_active_ingredients" ("product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medicine_profiles (product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ingredient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES active_ingredients (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "normalized_strength_value_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "normalized_strength_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_basis_value_micros" INTEGER NULL, "normalized_basis_unit" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "ingredient_id"), CHECK (normalized_strength_value_micros > 0), CHECK (normalized_basis_value_micros IS NULL OR normalized_basis_value_micros > 0), CHECK ((normalized_basis_value_micros IS NULL AND normalized_basis_unit IS NULL) OR (normalized_basis_value_micros IS NOT NULL AND normalized_basis_unit IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "promotions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "name_fr" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "promotion_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "application_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'automatic', "concurrency_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'best_price', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES currencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retail', "coupon_code" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "starts_at" TEXT NULL, "ends_at" TEXT NULL, "max_applications_per_transaction" INTEGER NULL, "max_applications_per_customer" INTEGER NULL, "allow_manual_discount_combination" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_manual_discount_combination" IN (0, 1)), "allow_below_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_below_cost" IN (0, 1)), "created_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "updated_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));
